request.query: The natural degree of substituting X for every variable of a multivariate polynomial is at most its total degree

items.name: MvPolynomial.aeval_natDegree_le
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type v} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {m n : ℕ} (F : MvPolynomial σ R),
  F.totalDegree ≤ m →
    ∀ (f : σ → Polynomial R), (∀ (i : σ), (f i).natDegree ≤ n) → ((MvPolynomial.aeval f) F).natDegree ≤ m * n

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_le_totalDegree
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R) (i : σ),
  MvPolynomial.degreeOf i f ≤ f.totalDegree

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf
items.type: {R : Type u} → {σ : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → σ → MvPolynomial σ R → ℕ

items.name: MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous.totalDegree_le
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] {φ : MvPolynomial σ R} {n : ℕ},
  φ.IsHomogeneous n → φ.totalDegree ≤ n

items.name: MvPolynomial.totalDegree
items.type: {R : Type u} → {σ : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial σ R → ℕ
